facts.title: Shader Gradient Background Generator - Animated WebGL Gradients & Video Export | MagicPattern
facts.description: Online shader gradient background generator. Create liquid, silk, streaked and grainy WebGL gradients with wave distortion and retro dithering, then export high-res images or looping MP4/WebM videos for websites and branding.

research.name: Shader Gradient Background Generator
research.note: Browser editor for WebGL shader gradients with mesh waves, distortion, dithering and grain, exported as image or looping video.

effects: WebGL shader gradient with mesh-wave frequency, sharpness, amplitude and warp distortion controls
Retro Bayer dithering and film grain filters on the gradient
Video mode with keyframes and timeline exporting looping MP4/WebM

unverified: Freemium is inferred from the tool page calling itself free while MagicPattern's pricing page sells Basic ($10) and Pro ($20) plans; which export features need a plan was not checked.
